test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 12 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain coded language 'AWLS' is coded as 'EBPX' and 'ARCS' is coded as 'EWGX'. How will 'BATS' be coded in the same code language?
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43afa64b4588a9146d43550587fd1cb713d5116935723879cdda136757bf1085.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'AWLS' is coded as 'EBPX'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/78067361284338c1a30da21aa32b1f6863992852f614c144ea8a54d2b830cb8a.png] 

'ARCS' is coded as 'EWGX'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5bca6e5f0c90d67f8d18df32d07d0eb6bc0773b5fe6e248e8a2b833a9e2813f.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0419d36eebc6970ed0739cf03711b9e928688545e643521df7f6de643d229673.png] 

Thus, 'BATS' is coded as 'FFXX'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
